description: This file defines the 'Reward' class within the Opencart Admin Controller Mail namespace. It handles the process of sending reward point notification emails to customers. The class extends the core Controller class and includes a method 'index' that constructs and sends an email based on customer reward data, including loading relevant language files, store info, and configuration settings.

classes.name: Reward
classes.description: Handles the sending of reward point notification emails to customers.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Constructs and sends an email to a customer informing them of reward points.
